lines.text: Every month, your finance team opens thousands of invoices.
Some are billed twice. Some are priced wrong. Some arrive before the goods do. And some... aren't who they say they are.
Duly reads every invoice, whether it's a PDF, a scan, or a photo from a phone, and checks it against the purchase order, and what actually arrived.
Then it decides. Approve. Flag. Or block. Always with a reason you can see.
The rules make the call. AI only reads, and explains.
It catches the duplicate, sent as a photo. The bank account that quietly changed. Even hidden instructions, written for the AI.
It pays small suppliers on time, every time, and puts your cash to work.
Suppliers always know where their money is. In English, or in Hindi.
And every decision is sealed, in a tamper-evident audit trail.
